title: Account Executive
description:
Accounts Executive
 



 Organization: Kingston Educational Institute (KEI)
 



 Location: Barasat / Madhyamgram, West Bengal
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



 Salary: 15000/\- to 20000/\-
 



 Experience: 1–3 Years
 



  





 Role Overview:
 



 We are looking for a detail\-oriented and experienced Accounts Executive to manage day\-to\-day accounting operations, maintain financial records, and ensure compliance with statutory requirements. The candidate should possess strong accounting knowledge and hands\-on experience in GST, Tally, and Accounts Finalisation.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 



 Accounting \& Financial Operations:
 



 Maintain day\-to\-day accounting transactions and financial records
 



 Handle journal entries, ledger posting, bank reconciliation, and account maintenance
 



 Prepare vouchers, invoices, payment records, and supporting documentation
 



 Ensure accuracy in financial data and accounting records
 



  





 GST \& Compliance:
 



 Prepare and file GST returns within prescribed timelines
 



 Maintain GST records and ensure compliance with applicable regulations
 



 Reconcile GST data and support audit requirements
 



 Assist in handling statutory compliance\-related activities
 



  





 Accounts Finalisation:
 



 Assist in monthly, quarterly, and annual accounts finalisation
 



 Prepare financial statements and reports
 



 Support internal and external audits
 



 Reconcile accounts and ensure proper documentation
 



  





 Software \& MIS Reporting:
 



 Manage accounting entries and records using Tally
 



 Generate financial reports and MIS statements
 



 Maintain and update accounting data regularly
 



 Prepare reports required by management
 



  





  





  





 Requirements:
 



 B.Com (Mandatory)/M.Com (Desirable)
 



 Knowledge of GST (Mandatory)
 



 Knowledge of Tally (Mandatory)
 



 Knowledge of ERP system
 



 Accounts Finalisation experience is mandatory
 



 Good understanding of accounting principles and financial processes
 



 Proficiency in MS Excel and MS Office
 



  





 Preferred:
 



 Experience in Educational Institution / Hospital / Service sector preferred
 



 Knowledge of statutory compliance and taxation will be an added advantage
 



  





 Key Skills:
 



 Accounting \& bookkeeping
 



 GST compliance
 



 Tally ERP
 



 Accounts finalisation
 



 Financial reporting \& MIS
 



 Attention to detail and analytical skills

title: Outbound Executive - Night Shift - US Process
description:
**Company Description** 
 V Engineering LLC is a leading staffing organization focused on connecting businesses with the right talent. For over a decade, the company has maintained a strong customer retention rate and serves clients and candidates across the globe. Its team of trained professionals leverages modern tools and methodologies to effectively bridge the gap between employers and job seekers. V Engineering LLC promotes a high\-standard work culture and strong ethics, striving to consistently place the right talent with the right organization. This commitment to quality makes it a trusted partner in the staffing industry.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Outbound Executive \- Night Shift \- US Process role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Rajarhat. The role involves making outbound calls to prospective and existing clients or candidates in the US, following defined scripts and guidelines while maintaining professional communication standards. Daily tasks include understanding customer needs, providing accurate information, addressing basic inquiries, and escalating complex issues when necessary. The Outbound Executive will document call outcomes, update internal systems, and collaborate with the team to meet or exceed performance targets related to customer satisfaction and process efficiency. The position requires adherence to night shift schedules aligned with US time zones and maintaining consistent quality in customer interactions.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Customer\-focused skills, including Customer Service and Customer Support, to handle inquiries and provide a positive experience.
* Ability to maintain high Customer Satisfaction through proactive engagement and professional follow\-up.
* Strong Communication skills, both verbal and written, suitable for outbound calls to international customers.
* Analytical Skills to understand customer needs, interpret feedback, and support continuous improvement in processes.
* Previous experience in outbound calling, BPO, or US process roles is preferred.
* Comfortable working night shifts and on\-site in Rajarhat, with reliable attendance and time management.
* Basic computer literacy and ability to work with CRM or call management tools.
* Minimum high school diploma or equivalent; a degree in any discipline is an advantage.

title: Business Development Executive- Night Shift - US Process - Freshers are welcome
description:
**Company Description** 
 V Engineering LLC is a leading staffing organization focused on strengthening businesses by connecting them with the right talent. For over a decade, the company has maintained strong client relationships and high customer retention across global markets. Its team of trained professionals leverages modern tools and processes to efficiently bridge the gap between employers and candidates. The company is known for its ethical work culture and commitment to placing suitable talent with the right customers. This environment offers growth opportunities for individuals looking to build a career in business development and staffing services.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Business Development Executive role based in Rajarhat, working in the night shift for a US process; freshers are welcome to apply. The role involves prospecting and identifying potential clients, generating leads through calls, emails, and online platforms, and qualifying opportunities for staffing solutions. The Business Development Executive will support the sales pipeline by scheduling meetings, maintaining client databases, and following up on inquiries to build long\-term relationships. Daily responsibilities include coordinating with internal teams to understand staffing needs, preparing basic proposals or presentations, and contributing to strategies that expand the company’s presence in the US market. The position requires consistent documentation of activities, adherence to performance targets, and a professional approach while representing V Engineering LLC to external stakeholders.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess skills in New Business Development and Business to identify opportunities and support revenue growth.
* Candidates should possess skills in Lead Generation to build and maintain a robust pipeline of prospective clients.
* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills to interact effectively with clients and internal teams in a professional manner.
* Candidates should possess skills in Account Management to support ongoing client relationships and basic post\-sales coordination.
* Comfortable working night shifts aligned to US business hours and in an on\-site environment in Rajarhat.
* Ability to work with targets, use CRM or spreadsheet tools for tracking, and manage time efficiently.
* Good command of spoken and written English; additional international exposure is an advantage.
* Undergraduate degree in any discipline preferred; freshers or candidates with up to 2 years of relevant experience are encouraged to apply.

title: Associate Partner
description:
**Company Description** 
 Aditya Birla Capital is a diversified financial services group within the Aditya Birla Group, offering solutions across life insurance, health insurance, mutual funds, lending, and other financial products. The company focuses on helping individuals and businesses meet their financial goals through responsible, customer\-centric advisory and service. It emphasizes ethical practices, long\-term relationships, and sustainable growth across its businesses. Team members work in a collaborative, performance\-driven environment with opportunities for learning, development, and career advancement.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Associate Partner role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Barasat. In this role, the individual will identify and acquire new customers, explain suitable financial and insurance products, and support clients in making informed financial decisions. Daily responsibilities include meeting prospective customers, following up on leads, conducting needs analysis, and maintaining strong relationships with existing clients. The Associate Partner will collaborate with the local branch team, participate in sales and training activities, and ensure adherence to company policies and regulatory guidelines. The role also involves achieving sales targets, preparing basic reports on customer interactions, and providing consistent service to enhance customer satisfaction and retention.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong customer relationship and communication skills, with the ability to explain financial products clearly and build trust.
* Ability to work towards sales and business development targets, including prospecting, follow\-ups, and closing transactions.
* Basic understanding or interest in financial services, insurance, and investment products, with readiness to learn and upskill.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills to handle multiple client interactions and documentation efficiently.
* Minimum educational qualification: typically a bachelor’s degree in any discipline; relevant experience in sales, banking, or insurance is an advantage.
* Comfort working in an on\-site, field\-oriented role in Barasat, with willingness to travel locally for client meetings.
* Professional, ethical mindset with a focus on customer service, compliance, and long\-term relationship building.

title: Senior Branch Manager
description:
* POSITION DESCRIPTION


 JOB TITLE : Senior Branch Manager
   

  

 GRADE : AVP\-I
   

  

 DEPARTMENT : Branch Banking, TASC, TPP
   

  

 LOCATION : Branch
   

  

 SUB\-DEPARTMENT : Branch Banking

 REPORTS TO : Cluster Head/Regional Head – Branch Banking
   

  

 REPORTING INTO
   

  

**Direct Reporting**
* BDE/AAM/AM
* BSM/CA\-AM
* Dotted line reporting of certain Silver \& Gold Branch Heads
* Dotted line reporting of BOO/BOSM
* ROLE PURPOSE \& OBJECTIVE
* This role is responsible for driving the entire business targets for liabilities assigned to the branch; Manage exceptional customer service, proactive sales environment and efficient branch operations, while adhering to regulations/compliance requirements; Focus on retaining existing customers, increasing the customer base and cross\-selling Ujjivan’s products and services; Oversee branch operations, cash management and service quality; work closely with product and marketing teams to drive campaigns at their branches.
* This role monitors daily performance of branch staff and manages a team of 10 to 15 employees.
* This role manages leadership reporting of BOO/BOSM \& BSM.
* In certain cases will have dotted line reporting of few Silver \& Gold Branch Heads reporting to them
* This role is assigned higher targets for their respective branches and is applicable only to Platinum \& Titanium Branches.
* SIZE OF THE ROLE


 FINANCIAL SIZE
   

  

 NON\-FINANCIAL SIZE
   

  

* Entire liability target for the branch
* CASA Book – as per the branch
* TASC Book – as per the branch
* BB\-FIG Book – as per the branch
* Segment wise book (NR, Senior Citizen, HNI etc) – as per the branch
* Number target for all the respective products.
* CA
* SA
* TASC
* Snr Citizen
* HNI
* NR
* KEY DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE ROLE


**Business**
* Implement branch specific marketing \& communication strategies to continuously strengthen the Ujjivan brand.
* This role is responsible for driving the entire business targets for liabilities assigned to the branch.
* Manage exceptional customer service, proactive sales environment and efficient branch operations, while adhering to regulations/compliance requirements
* Focus on retaining existing customers, increasing the customer base and cross\-selling Ujjivan’s products and services
* Oversee branch operations, cash management and service quality; work closely with product and marketing teams to drive campaigns at their branches.
* Monitor daily performance of branch staff.
* To manage a team of 10 to 15 employees.
* To manage leadership reporting of BOO/BOSM \& BSM
* In certain cases, they will have a dotted line reporting of few Silver \& Gold Branch Heads reporting to them
* Will be assigned higher targets for their respective branches.
* Cascade targets the branch targets to the respective staffs and ensure achievement is tracked through periodic reviews.
* Ensure all deferrals taken are cleared within the specific period.
* Monitor the overall portfolio of the branch; ensure adherence to compliance and regulatory norms are met


**Customers**
* Ensure customers are educated about all products/services offered by Ujjivan
* Ensure courteous customer service is offered to customers by the branch staff
* Reduce customer attrition by guiding CCR(s) on exit interviews, customer engagement programs etc.
* Lead customer connect initiatives in the branch vicinity


**Internal Process**
* Oversee and ensure efficiency in branch/ATM operations through adherence to TAT for various internal and customer end processes; drive utilization of alternate channels
* Ensure compliance with banking guidelines, quality framework and audit requirements; ensure speedy resolution of any audit observations and take necessary steps to prevent recurrence,


 ensure compliance with Know Your Customer (KYC), Anti\- Money Laundering (AML), audit and other regulations \& applicable laws in the branch
   

  

* Monitor, control \& minimize all expenses in the Branch, such as telephone, consumption of stationery, computer consumables, electricity and other overheads without sacrificing quality
* Oversee accurate cash management and tallying of accounts in the system through the Cashier
* Accountable for branch safety including security of cash/vault etc.


**Learning \& Performance**
* Ensure that all members of the Branch staff are up to date on all relevant circulars and all products/services offered in the Branch
* Ensure adherence to training man\-days/ mandatory training programs for self and reportees
* Ensure goal\-setting, mid\-year review and annual appraisal process within specified timelines for self and reportees
* Monitor performance of staff against defined goals/metrics and take corrective action wherever required; undertake disciplinary and attendance monitoring for liabilities sales team and branch operations team
* Coordinate with state HR on people related matters; support branch activities to foster teamwork and continuously make Ujjivan a great place to work
* Ensure coordination between staff of different teams, to build a collaborative spirit and shared sense of purpose (which could also enable cross\-sell and overall target achievement)
* MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS OF KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS


 Educational
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Graduate in Commerce/Business/Economics or related subjects. PGDM/ MBA from a Tier 2 or 3 college preferred


**Experience**
* Should have overall experience of 8\-12 Years in core banking sales with good knowledge of banking products and regulatory requirements in banking.
* Should have worked as a Branch Manager for at least 2\-3 years.

 Functional Skills
   

  

* Sales \& marketing skills – across multiple products.
* Should have managed a deposit book of 75 to 300 Cr.
* Knowledge on liabilities products \& unsecured loans products
* Knowledge of basic accounting and finance administration
* Analytical skills
* Process \& Compliance Orientation: Knowledgeable on KYC norms/guidelines for liabilities \& unsecured loans


 Behavioral Skills
   

  

* Managing Customer Relations and excellent service orientation and relationship management skills
* Communication Skills \- fluent in the local language \& English
